how_to_change: The source owner approves a new or changed label or rule by merging a pull request that edits this file, then regenerates etl/03_silver (docs/operations/silver.md). A label that is not listed here fails the Silver gate (labels_mapped_*); it is never accepted silently.

identifier.note: COD-AB P-code, kept as text exactly as published. It is not a PSGC code: matching to PSGC is Integration's job (03_map_hdx_adm3_psgc), checking names as well as codes, because COD-AB reuses some PSGC code numbers for different units (#74, HB-2). A blank, malformed, or repeated value quarantines the row.

code_columns.note: Parent P-codes, kept as text exactly as published. Each must match its pattern, and the chain must hold: adm3_pcode starts with adm2_pcode, adm2_pcode starts with adm1_pcode, adm0_pcode is PH. A broken chain sets hierarchy_consistent = FALSE; the row is kept. Bronze check 2026-10-09: 0 broken chains.

free_text_note: Whitespace trimmed and collapsed, blank to NULL; no character repair. Bronze check 2026-10-09: 0 values with extra spaces, 0 mojibake. adm3_ref_name is adm3_name without the letter ñ (23 rows, e.g. Peñablanca / Penablanca); both are kept as published.

blank_columns.note: Alternate-language name fields, blank in all 1,642 rows of v03. Kept as text so a later version that fills them needs no schema change; cleaned like free text (blank to NULL).

adm1_name.rule: Region names as COD-AB v03 publishes them (17 regions, before the Negros Island Region). Kept as published; comparability with PSGC regions is an Integration concern.

version.rule: COD-AB edition. A new edition is a new delivery and a reviewed change to this file.

date_columns.note: Cast to DATE. A blank stays NULL. A value that does not cast quarantines the row (valid_on_uncastable / valid_to_uncastable). valid_on equals the delivery's reference date (2025-02-13), which Bronze already enforces. valid_to is blank in all 1,642 rows. Bronze check 2026-10-09: 0 failures.

decimal_columns.note: Cast to DECIMAL with enough scale that no published digit is rounded (D-023). A value that does not cast quarantines the row. Bronze check 2026-10-09: area_sqkm up to 4 integer and 14 decimal digits; center_lat up to 8 decimals; center_lon up to 3 integer and 14 decimal digits; 0 failures.

area_sqkm.evidence: min 0.399814, max 2341.43, zeros 0. A zero or negative area quarantines the row (area_not_positive); a blank area stays NULL and the row is kept (D-023).

center_lon.evidence: min 114.285, max 126.426 (west edge is Kalayaan, Palawan).

geometry.note: Kept as the published GeoJSON text (D-023, and the same value on DuckDB and Databricks); never simplified, reprojected, or repaired. The build parses every row: a geometry that does not parse (geometry_unparseable), is empty (geometry_empty), or is not Polygon/MultiPolygon (geometry_wrong_type) quarantines the row. A geometry that parses but is not valid is kept and flagged (geometry_is_valid = FALSE). center_inside_geometry = FALSE flags a published centre outside its own shape. Feasibility 2026-10-09, DuckDB 1.4.5 spatial and Databricks DBR 19.9: 1,642 parsed, 1,642 valid, 0 empty, 1,273 Polygon and 369 MultiPolygon, all centres inside their shapes.

quarantine.note: The gate WARNs when any feature is quarantined and FAILs when more than this percent of a batch's features are, so a broken delivery is never published. 1% of 1,642 is 16 features; the 2026-10-09 checks found none to quarantine.

flags.hierarchy_consistent: adm3 → adm2 → adm1 P-code chain holds and adm0_pcode = PH.
flags.geometry_is_valid: ST_IsValid of the parsed geometry. Invalid shapes are kept, never repaired.
flags.center_inside_geometry: The published centre point lies inside the published shape.
